description: This file defines a grain class for Orleans, including a serializable state class and grain methods for managing a list of names.

classes.name: Initialized_State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the grain's state, containing a list of names.

classes.name: InitialStateGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing IInitialStateGrain, managing a list of names with methods to retrieve and add names.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the list of names stored in the grain's state.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Adds a new name to the grain's state and persists the change.
